standard_prerequisites.name: The description of a colimit of sheaves as the sheafification of the presheaf of colimits of the sections, and the description of the tensor product of sheaves as a sheafification of a presheaf tensor product
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Both are invoked at the start of the counted proof (source lines 2637-2644) as a cross-chapter pointer and a pointer to a lemma of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the statement to a computation with presheaves of sections.

standard_prerequisites.name: The commutation of the tensor product of modules with colimits over a ring, and the description of colimits of modules on a ringed space
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Both are invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 2647-2653) as a cross-chapter pointer and a pointer to a lemma of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the presheaf of the tensor product with the colimit of the presheaves of the tensored terms, which is the statement.

core_obligations: Reduce to presheaves: writing the colimit as the sheafification of the presheaf of colimits of sections and the tensor product as the sheafification of the presheaf tensor product, the proof reduces the statement to a computation of presheaves (proof lines 2636-2649)

Compute on sections: over an open the tensor product of the sections of the fixed module with the colimit of the sections of the system is the colimit of the tensor products, by the algebraic statement that tensor products commute with colimits (proof lines 2647-2651)
Conclude: the description of colimits of modules on a ringed space then gives the result, since both sides are the sheafification of the colimit of the same presheaves (proof lines 2652-2653)
proof_roadmap: 把 colim_i G_i 写成预层 U ↦ colim_i G_i(U) 的层化（跨章）；由 lemma-tensor-product-sheafification，F ⊗ G 是该预层与 F 的张量预层的层化。
在开集上 F(U) ⊗_{O_X(U)} colim_i G_i(U) = colim_i F(U) ⊗_{O_X(U)} G_i(U)（跨章代数引理），再用 Mod(O_X) 中余极限的描述（本章 lemma-limits-colimits）即得结论。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that tensoring with a fixed module commutes with arbitrary colimits in the category of modules on a ringed space (author lemma at source lines 2623-2633, label lemma-tensor-commute-colimits). The proof (source lines 2635-2654) rewrites both the colimit and the tensor product as sheafifications of presheaves of sections, commutes the colimit into the tensor product at the level of sections by the algebraic statement, and concludes from the description of colimits of modules (proof lines 2636-2653). The reduction to the presheaf level is the content. H2.
